papers.title: TokenCast: Forecasting Token Consumption During LLM Agent Execution
papers.abstract: When a large language model (LLM) agent executes the same task, token consumption can vary by over an order of magnitude across runs. The agent chooses its next steps based on tool feedback and intermediate results, while the growing context steadily inflates the input size of every subsequent call. papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2609.35760）：TokenCast 解决'同一任务 token 消耗跨 run 可变超一个数量级'这一对 agent 经济性的核心痛点，把 token consumption 建模为可组合的 cost model：可在执行前估计预算，随执行过程（context 增长 / tool feedback）动态刷新估值。这是 ai-agent × inference-serving × ai-k8s-platform 的'agent cost governance'工程化资产——把'token consumption'从隐性指标变成可显式观测、预测、调度的对象，与近期 inference cost / budgeted agent 研究形成'agent 经济性'主线；'composable cost model'的形态便于直接迁移到 RAG、tool-use、coding agent。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 cost model 形式化、训练数据、跨 agent 框架的兼容性。今日动作：即时试点方向，写'token-cast cost routing'checklist 草稿，关注与同批 35769 telescopic LM、35768 PDMD 形成'inference efficiency × agent cost governance'主线共振。

papers.title: Telescopic Language Models
papers.abstract: One deployed language model must often serve many compute budgets, yet serving each budget still means a separate training or compression run per point. We train a Telescopic Language Model (TLM) to be that continuum: a nested-capacity Transformer supervised by stochastic prefix supervision with a full anchor. papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2609.35769）：Telescopic Language Models（TLM）用 stochastic prefix supervision + full anchor，让一个 Transformer 同时成为多档容量的语言模型——每个 truncated prefix 都用 full-capacity next-token target 监督，每档都是合法 LM。这是 inference-serving 的'one-model-many-budgets'架构资产：直接把'按预算路由'从部署侧推向训练侧，省去 per-budget 单独训练 / 压缩；与 35760 TokenCast'agent cost governance'同属'inference efficiency'主线，但 35760 解决'agent 怎么花钱'，35769 解决'模型本身怎么支持多档'。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 prefix supervision 协议、anchor 设计、推理时调度策略。今日动作：即时试点方向，写'telescopic-LM multi-budget serving'checklist 草稿。

papers.title: PDMD: Projected Distribution Matching Distillation for Video Diffusion Models
papers.abstract: Modern video diffusion models require tens of denoising evaluations over long spatiotemporal token sequences. Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) reduces the number of function evaluations (NFE) to just a few. papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2609.35768）：PDMD（Projected Distribution Matching Distillation）把 DMD critic error 在进入 student update 前显式过滤，避免 student 在 critic 错误信号下累积偏移，从而稳定视频扩散模型 1-4 step 的蒸馏训练。这是 inference-serving × multimodal-agent 的'扩散蒸馏稳定性'资产：直接对应'tens of denoising evaluations over long spatiotemporal token sequences'这一视频扩散 inference 痛点；与 35769 telescopic LM、35760 TokenCast 同属'inference efficiency'主线，但 PDMD 偏向训练侧蒸馏稳定性。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 projection 操作、critic 形式、消融。今日动作：趋势卡片维护，做 1-2 周内多源证据复盘。

papers.abstract: Unified multimodal models can both look at and render images, so in principle they can repair their own generations: diagnose what an image gets wrong, revise it, observe the result, and diagnose again. Whether a revision helps is known only after it is rendered, so the reflection text and the image generation must be learned jointly, over the whole loop. papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2609.35763）：Unifying Distributional Training for One-Step Visual Generation 把 distributional training 拆为'distribution modeling'与'matching discrepancy'两部分，在 Wasserstein gradient flow 框架下把 FD-Loss 与 Gaussian-kernel Drifting 统一为 Gaussian optimal transport 与 kernel-density estimation 的特例。这是 inference-serving × llm-evaluation 的'一步生成理论统一'资产：长尾保存——为团队日后做'一步生成理论分析 / 跨方法对照'提供'Wasserstein 统一框架'具体范式；与 35768 PDMD'扩散蒸馏稳定性'、35769 telescopic LM'inference efficiency'在方法学层面同源。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 Wasserstein 流推导、跨方法消融。今日动作：沉淀为长尾卡片，标注'one-step generative model theoretical unification'触发条件。
